# Original fallback test fonts

GPL-3.0-only, copyright 2026 EXReader contributors. These tiny fonts contain only
original rectangles and a parallelogram, generated by `tools/generate_test_fonts.py`
using fontTools. No system font outlines are included. Normal builds use these
committed binaries and do not require fontTools.

Primary covers space/A/V/a, 500-unit advances, 800/-200 vertical metrics, A/V kern -100.
Fallback also covers U+0301, U+7532, U+4E59 and U+1F600, with 900-unit advances,
1200/-400 metrics and A/V kern -300; U+7532 deliberately maps to the V glyph.
The marks-only font covers U+0301 and U+03B2. Combining acute has zero advance.
The collection contains primary at face 0 and fallback at face 1.

The oversize font uses original 32000-unit rectangles at 1000 units per em. It verifies
that glyph rasterization refuses huge temporary bitmaps before asking FreeType to render.

The glyph-only font preserves the primary outlines and glyph order without a cmap table or PostScript glyph names.
It tests direct glyph rendering independently of Unicode lookup.


The five `pdf-*` fonts come from `tools/generate_pdf_test_fonts.py`, under the
same GPL-3.0-only notice. They contain original rectangle/triangle/quadratic/
cubic contours. `pdf-names.ttf` uses 2000 units per em and retains PostScript
names; `pdf-unicode.ttf` omits them; `pdf-symbol.ttf` uses a Microsoft symbolic
cmap. `pdf-cubic.otf` has ordinary CFF outlines and `pdf-cid.otf` has CID-keyed
CFF with deliberately sparse CIDs (1, 42, 77, 99). No external outlines are used.


The three `vertical-*` fonts are original rectangles/triangles from
`tools/generate_vertical_test_fonts.py` (GPL-3.0-only). They distinguish native
vmtx metrics, vert fallback, vrt2 priority and vertical kerning; the plain face
omits vertical metrics/alternates to exercise em and orientation fallback.


`variable.ttf` is an original two-axis rectangle/mark font from
`tools/generate_variable_test_font.py` (GPL-3.0-only). Nine original masters
produce avar, gvar, HVAR/VVAR, variable kern/mark and an rvrn condition; the hidden
width axis and named heavy instance test public instance ownership and queries.

`color.ttf` is an original COLR v0/CPAL rectangle font, generated by
`tools/generate_color_test_font.py` under GPL-3.0-only. Two palettes include
opaque, translucent and transparent colors, plus the foreground entry. The
font also exercises 256/257 layers and a deliberately oversized layer. Its
SHA-256 is `86ca5558811aae81749d0057a348e9b7c453d1e6fe66f553d3fbb3bb38314c15`.

`bitmap.ttf` derives only from these original outlines, under the same license.
`tools/generate_bitmap_test_font.py` builds two sbix strikes with original
two-color PNGs and a solid JPEG, partial glyph coverage, dupe chains and a
deliberate cyclic reference. SHA-256 is
`b197c58d0ed858a2134bad58d03decd912cb5dee2080284dc7ea0802a8b525b6`.
